item.title: Qualcomm's Oryon 3 Reaches the Top
item.description:
📝 To deliver that performance, Qualcomm relies on the third generation of their in-house Oryon architecture, which I’ll call Oryon 3 for short. Oryon 3 takes on this burden by deploying an architecture with a strong resemblance to the first Oryon generation. From Oryon 1, Oryon 3 inherits an out-of-order window in excess of 600 micro-ops.
🔗 Read more: https://chipsandcheese.com/p/qualcomms-oryon-3-reaches-the-top
